text: BAM share rose 1.12 percentage points over 23 hours and 0.26 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 37.7% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 22.1% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 4. The 68 leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover.
